title: fix(plugin-approvals): the approval request page's highlights strip names the current step by its label
body:
Fixes #24281

Clause-②: no

The served `sys_approval_request_detail` record page's highlights strip now names the current step by its label. It lists `current_step_label` (the "Approval Step" field) where it listed `current_step`, the Approval node's machine id, so a request waiting on the `lead_review` node reads `Lead Review` there. The approvals get's row builder now serves `current_step_label`, the member `ApprovalRequestRow` declares for this (`370833a303`, #24309), with the value `step_label` carries. The object's `highlightFields` makes the same swap.

Responsibility: `plugin-approvals`' own row builder and page declaration | the platform path is the declared column `current_step_label` and its contract member, both on `main`, which the row builder did not serve under that name | reached by every user who opens a pending request's served page, whose Current Step chip showed the node's machine id.

Readings are against objectstack `c4526a705` (this branch's base) and objectui at the console pin `.objectui-sha` = `0707b4ae3`, by `git show` and `git grep`, plus one wire reading on a booted showcase (below). The page was not driven in a browser.

## Which of the card's two routes, and why

The card asks the fix to say which: **the get now serves the label under a field name the page can list.** The page names its object's declared fields, and `step_label` is not one. `current_step_label` is a declared field of `sys_approval_request` and a declared member of `ApprovalRequestRow`, so `rowFromRequest` serves it from the same `requestDisplayLabels` value as `step_label`. No new column, field, formula or contract member, and no `packages/spec` edit.

## Which doors gain the member

`rowFromRequest` is the only builder of a served `ApprovalRequestRow`. It has three call sites, and no other site builds a row:

- `openNodeRequest`'s return;
- `listRequests`, behind `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests`;
- `loadRequest`, behind `getRequest` (`GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/ID`) and `readBackRequest`. `readBackRequest` builds the `request` that `decideNode`, `recall`, `sendBack`, `resubmit`, `reassign`, `remind`, `requestInfo` and `comment` echo back. The action-token chain behind the emailed links also reads through `getRequest`.

The two REST routes pass the rows through unchanged (`res.json`, `packages/rest/src/approvals-routes.ts`). So every one of these doors now serves `current_step_label` beside `step_label`.

## Readers of `step_label`, measured

`step_label` stays served, with the same value. No reader moves.

- This repo: `action-link-pages.ts:66` (`req.step_label || req.current_step`), the emailed confirm and result pages. Unchanged.
- objectui at the pin: the inbox (`apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx:314`, `:1525`; the type in `approvalsApi.ts:68`) and the record page's approvals panel (`packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordApprovalsPanel.tsx:372`; the type in `useRecordApprovals.ts:97`). Unchanged.
- No objectui source reads `current_step_label` at the pin, so the added key changes nothing for an existing reader.

## The strip and the object's list change together

The rule in the page header still holds at the pin. The Details tab is a bare `record:details` node. objectui's `record-details.tsx` draws the object's `highlightFields` minus the mounted strip when a node authors neither `sections` nor `fields` (`bodyFieldsOmitted`, objectui#12433). A strip-only swap would have put a "Current Step: lead_review" row into that tab. So both lists swap `current_step` for `current_step_label`, and the object's list minus the strip is still exactly `record_id`.

Other readers of the object's `highlightFields`, re-read at the pin (the same census PR #24279 took):

- `ObjectView` and `ObjectGrid` default columns: only for a list view that declares no `columns`. All four `sys_approval_request` list views declare columns, and three already list `current_step_label`. Not reached.
- `InterfaceListPage` default columns, `ObjectKanban` card fields, `RelatedList` default columns: no interface page, kanban view or related list of requests is declared in this repository. Not reached.
- `deriveLookupColumns` (lookup picker preview): the two lookups to a request, `sys_approval_action.request_id` and `sys_approval_approver.request_id`, sit on objects whose `enable.apiMethods` is `['get', 'list']`, so no create or edit form opens that picker. Not reached.
- `RecordDetailView`'s synthesized default page: not used, since this page is assigned (`isDefault: true`).
- `RecordPreviewCard`, the card a `referenceVia` pointer pair draws: reached only where a pointer pair names a request row. Whether such rows exist is NOT MEASURED. Where they do, the card shows the step's label where it showed the node id.
- Studio's object settings panel shows the list as authored.
- Backend readers (`@objectstack/lint` field references and semantic roles, `metadata-core`'s field-security fold, `metadata-protocol`'s build probes): none changes behaviour for a list of existing fields. `current_step_label` is the fifth entry, outside the first four that the field-group shadow rule reads. The page test's build-rule leg stays green.

## The null case: what the chip shows

The console reads a request through the approvals get (`routeApprovalRecordReads`). The get serves `current_step_label` by the one chain in `display-labels.ts`:

- **A label is stored** (every request opened since the column, and every row the boot backfill filled): the stored label. `openNodeRequest` stores the authored node label, else the humanized node id.
- **No label stored, the snapshot carries one** (a row opened before the column that the backfill has not reached): the snapshot's `__nodeLabel`.
- **No label stored and none in the snapshot**: the humanized node id (`approve_step` becomes `Approve Step`), never the raw id.
- **No step at all** (`current_step` null and no label anywhere): neither field is served. The strip draws no step chip, as it drew no `current_step` chip before.
- **The same record read through the generic data API** (a host without the console's routing): the chip reads the stored column. It is null only on a row the boot fill has not labelled, and the chip is then absent where it used to show the raw id.

## The `object_name` chip: measured, the same family, not fixed here

- **What it draws.** The get serves `object_name` as stored, the target object's API name. On the booted showcase below it answers `showcase_announcement`. At the pin, `HeaderHighlight` draws a `text` field through the text cell renderer, which prints the stored string. The pointer-pair handling (`resolveRecordPointer`) applies only to the `record_id` id half, and only in the details grid and the list grid. So the Object chip reads `showcase_announcement`. That is a static reading of the renderer plus a wire reading of the value, not a screen reading.
- **Why it is not fixed here.** The get also serves `object_label` (`Announcement` on the same request), but `sys_approval_request` declares no field that holds the target object's label (its 23 declared fields were read). A page bound to the object names declared fields only: this page's own pin, "every field the page names exists on its object", holds that. So a label chip needs a new member, which this card's claim excludes. It is reported to the seat with its reach and is not built.

## Tests (at `2ff7f0350`)

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/plugin-approvals^...' build`: VERDICT command-exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals build`: exit 0, at `b62923f9d`. The one commit after it changes only a test file.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals test`: `Test Files 81 passed (81)`, `Tests 1111 passed (1111)` (1108 before, plus the 3 below).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals typecheck`: exit 0, `check:test-typecheck: OK — … 8 file(s) / 324 error(s) / 27 pinned signature(s) held`. The first spelling of the new test read `.id` off the open result, a union with the auto-outcome, and grew `approval-service.test.ts`'s debt by 7 (`189 type error(s), ledger records 182`). The second commit narrows it with a typed id helper, as the file's other helpers do.
- Three new cases, named and green (`--reporter=verbose -t current_step_label`):
  - `approval-service.test.ts` › the get serves the step label as current_step_label, beside step_label › a labelled row serves its stored label. It also asserts that the list door serves the same three fields as the get.
  - › a row opened before the column serves the snapshot label, else the humanized machine id.
  - `sys-approval-request-page.test.ts` › names the step by its label, current_step_label, in the strip and in the object's list alike.
  - Control in each: `current_step` is still served raw (`approve_step`) and is still a declared field.

**Ablation (once, then restored; repeated on the final head).** `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` dropped the served line `current_step_label: labels.current_step_label,` from `rowFromRequest`, inside a script with its own `trap` restore. The test imports the service by relative path, so `src/` is what runs and no `dist/` is involved. On-disk evidence: anchor x1 → x0, blob `b137eedb4067` → `2739baafe590`. Expected direction: red. Observed: `Tests 2 failed | 1 passed`. Both get cases failed with `expected { current_step_label: undefined, …(2) } to deeply equal { …(3) }`, and the page pin stayed green (it does not read the get). Restore leg: blob after restore == HEAD (`b137eedb4067`), `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status` clean. No test file is left behind.

**Wire reading (booted showcase, this branch's build).** `pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 38241`, signed in as the seeded admin. Retitling a `showcase_announcement` (the `showcase_dynamic_approval` flow's trigger) opened a pending request at the `lead_review` node. `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/ID` answered `current_step_label: "Lead Review"`, `step_label: "Lead Review"`, `current_step: "lead_review"`, `object_name: "showcase_announcement"`, `object_label: "Announcement"`. `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests` answered the same step fields. The served metadata lists the strip `["process_label","object_name","status","current_step_label","submitter_id","updated_at"]` and the object's `highlightFields` `["process_label","object_name","record_id","status","current_step_label","submitter_id","updated_at"]`. The server was stopped after the reading.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `2ff7f0350` derived 69 commands for this diff, the same 69 the seat derived at `83dfbc046`. All 69 ran locally at `2ff7f0350`, each exit code captured before any pipe. All 69 exited 0, and none printed a PREREQUISITE NOT MET refusal of its own (the CLI and the showcase closure had been built for the wire reading).

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` with the exit-coded record: `69 derived, 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` ("a DERIVED zero — all 69 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3").

The longest local runs were `check:query-options-erasure` (235 s), `check:slot-lookup` (123 s) and `check-comment-mask-corpus` (107 s).

Not run locally, declared to CI: `test:repo` (the vitest `repo` project; the diff touches neither its tests nor a list naming it), and the repo-wide scans (`pnpm lint` and the rest of the battery). The PR's check-runs are the reading. `check:dev-prereqs` and `check:skill-frame-freshness` are not derived and not owed (no `packages/spec` build input and no frame file changed).

## Acceptance notes

- **The Object chip still shows the target object's API name** (section above). It is the same family as this card, and a label needs a declared field the claim excludes. It is reported to the seat, not built.
- **objectui's served-page pin copies** (`apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource.servedPage*.test.tsx`, 8 files at the pin) copy the strip and the object's list with `current_step`. Their field maps declare no `current_step_label`, and their row fixtures are shaped as the get served a request before this PR, without it. objectstack-ai/objectui#12484 carries them. They are not touched here.
- `ApprovalRequestRow.current_step_label`'s TSDoc says the member was "declared ahead of its producer", which this PR is. The sentence names this card as the producer's, so it stays true. It is a `packages/spec` file and is not touched here.
- `origin/main` moved one commit past this branch's base (`a2a3777bf`, docs-only, none of the touched paths). The branch is not merged with it. CI's merge ref and the queue read the merged tree.
